results.title: Athletics-World Athletics unveils lane draft, jump-offs for new Ultimate Championship
results.description: Aug 20 (Reuters) - ⁠Sprinters will choose their own lanes, jump-offs will decide winners ⁠in the high jump and pole vault, and television viewers ‌will get win probabilities and live fan feedback when World Athletics launches its new Ultimate Championship.
